messages:
alex-cs: Hi team — customer (acme-inc) on prod reports 403s for generation + rerank but embeddings still work. They're blocked in their billing flow. Said nothing changed on their side.

alex-cs: Pasted the curl they sent:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"test"}'
```

Response:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"code":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scopes: generation, rerank"}}
```

devon-eng: thx alex. quick checks — can you confirm this is the same API key used for embeddings previously? if so we might have a scope-change migration issue.

alex-cs: yes customer_jane says embeddings endpoint worked for last 3 hours but generate/rerank started failing ~02:23 UTC. They gave request id: req_0a1b2c3d

irene-se: I pulled provisioning logs for that req_0a1b2c3d and the svc token was created by the SCIM sync job at 02:10 UTC. The SCIM payload shows scopes="embeddings" only. looks like the sync overwrote entitlements.

sam-ops: there's an ongoing csv-to-scim transformation change in the syncer that normalizes scope lists. Could be a delimiter edge-case. any tenant names with commas or unusual chars? acme-inc had a display name "ACME, Inc" recently.

devon-eng: that matches a known bug where display-name commas caused the CSV export to shift columns and we only captured the first column (embeddings). I'll triage the syncer asap.

alex-cs: customer wants repro steps and ETA. They asked: is there a short mitigation now? they need generate/rerank back for their billing pipeline.

irene-se: quick mitigation options:
- re-provision a new API key for them with explicit scopes: [generate, rerank, embeddings]
- or run an ad-hoc reconcile for that tenant to reapply entitlements

sam-ops: I can run a one-off reconcile for tenant acme-inc. requires approval because it touches SCIM state. devon — can you approve and run the script?

devon-eng: approving. I'll run reconcile now and follow with logs. tagging @provisioner-bot to capture audit.

provisioner-bot: Reconcile job queued by devon-eng for tenant acme-inc. Job id: recon_1767654321. Notifying when complete.

provisioner-bot: Reconcile complete — updated API key sk_live_ABC123 to scopes: generation, rerank, embeddings. Audit log: audit_1767654321

alex-cs: relayed to customer — they confirmed generate is now returning 200. rerank also OK. Customer asked for root cause & prevention.

devon-eng: root cause: CSV->SCIM syncer mis-parsed display names with commas and truncated scope lists during SCIM provisioning. I'll open a bug and add a schema validation check to the sync pipeline to reject malformed rows.

irene-se: follow-ups: 1) add reconciliation health check that compares active keys' scopes vs desired from IDP; 2) run a backfill for tenants updated between 02:00-02:30 UTC to catch similar cases.

alex-cs: customer very appreciative — asked for timeline for backfill. devon — please provide ETA in ticket.

devon-eng: filing bug now: BUG-2083 "scim-sync csv delimiter bug drops non-first scopes". ETA for fix + backfill: 48 hours. I'll post a status update in this thread and link the ticket.

alex-cs: thanks. closing interim with customer. adding note to ticket with customer contact (jane@acme.com) and sample req id.

customer-jane: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround! :heart:

sam-ops: postmortem tasks: run backfill, add unit tests for CSV parsing, add reconciliation alert. assigning to devon-eng + irene-se.
